author: reek
body: Regression guard: the full claim/proof/qed sugar must thread the claim's type to the proof body. Claiming Integer === Text and offering Refl must be rejected (CDX2001), exactly as the plain annotated-def form (refl-mismatch) is. This previously slipped through because the claim arm's then-branch was lost to dangling-else, so the claim type never reached the proof.
